The error is: `error[E0432]: unresolved import crate::errors` in `src/anthropic.rs:25:12`. This suggests that the `errors` module is not correctly exposed or located at `crate::errors`. I'll start by examining `src/anthropic.rs` to understand the context of the import.

I see the `unresolved import` error. According to the project rules and file structure, the `AgentError` enum is located within the `agent` module under `src-tauri/src/agent/errors.rs`.
